meta.title: Increase TTL for older posts
meta.body_summary: Set a 24-hour Cache-Control header for blog posts older than six months to improve caching efficiency, with tests verifying TTL behavior.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex authored a small cache TTL change for older posts; merged immediately by simonw with no review and one post-merge comment explaining 24h choice.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 20 changed lines across 2 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround caching performance PR and is consistent with the instant merge without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or blocking feedback; the PR was merged instantly by the author himself after the agent's commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Set 24-hour Cache-Control header for older posts to improve caching and reduce server load.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Straightforward cache header adjustment in a Django view with clear age-based logic; no friction in merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Simonw merged the PR immediately after seeing the commit; post-merge comment explained the rationale for 24h based on existing post content.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Tests check TTL behavior for old and new items but no benchmark or load test.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions were reported or handled.

core_change_summary.description: In blog/views.py, added logic to set Cache-Control max-age=86400 (24 hours) for posts older than six months; in blog/tests.py, added tests verifying TTL for old and new items.
change_trajectory: Single commit adjusted cache TTL and added tests; merged immediately with no review iteration.

review_signals.summary: Explained the decision for 24-hour TTL by referencing dynamic content pattern in older posts.

collaboration_trajectory: OpenAI_Codex created the PR with cache TTL change and tests.
Simonw merged instantly (<1 min) without review.
Post-merge, simonw added a comment explaining the 24h choice.
